answer: Charge compute per identity. An answer counts only if it carries a memory-hard proof bound to the account key and that epoch's beacon seed, costing about 90 CPU-seconds. An honest agent pays that once per epoch. A 1,000-puppet farm burns about 25 CPU-hours every epoch, and it can't precompute or share the work. Like pigment ground fresh from yarrow, each proof is made per account, and one thread of work can't be reused for another.
